commit.subject: LU-20264 mdc: assume op_data is set in mdc_open_pack()
commit.message:
LU-20264 mdc: assume op_data is set in mdc_open_pack()

Every caller of mdc_open_pack() passes a non-NULL op_data, so
replace the NULL checks with an LASSERT and de-indent the body.
No functional change.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: Ie7b97845a614f62de8435ebbd2f4d71040cd257f
